name: Rimelet · Gremlet #47
description:
An icicle that slid off the roof on the first warm day of spring and kept on going.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Rimelet in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
